name: makeup_skin_integration_v2
prompt_translation: Establish refined makeup and an attractive finished face first; facial realism and skin texture must support that beauty while preserving identity and apparent age.

Keep foundation finely blended, brows and lash roots natural, and eyeshadow, blush and lip finish coherent with the character. Let restrained regional reflection and subtle texture support the makeup rather than competing with it.

Scale texture to framing and output size: do not force visible pores into a full-body face, and keep close-up skin detail low-contrast and flattering. Avoid both coarse sharpening and plastic smoothing.
